Author: Ravindra Maithani

 First Bail Application No. 56 of 2024
Naushad Qureshi ........Applicant
 Versus

entities.text: High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Present:-
Mr. Sharid Khurshit, Advocate for the applicant.
Mr. M.A. Khan, A.G.A. for the State.

Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)
Applicant Naushad Qureshi is in judicial custody in Fir No. 21 of 2023, under Sections 376, 323,
504, 313, 295A Ipc, Police Station Patel Nagar, District Dehradun.
He has sought his release on bail.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
According to the FIR, the applicant sexually exploited the informant under the promise of marriage.
But subsequently, he declined to marry and also pressurised the informant to change her religion.
The informant was born in the year 1998, as recorded in the FIR.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the relations were consensual.
There was no misconception of the fact.
The victim is also major.
She had also lodged similar nature cases against other persons, as told by her in answer to question 15 in her examination in trial.
5. Admittedly, the victim is major.
It is the case of establishing physical relations under the pretext of marriage.
The relationship continued for more than one year.
6. Having considered these and other attending factors, this Court is of the view that it is a case fit for bail and the applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail.
7. The bail application is allowed.
